props.name: activationMode
props.description:
Whether arrow-key focus movement activates the tab immediately (`automatic`) or only moves
focus until `Enter` or `Space` confirms it (`manual`).

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially active tab value for uncontrolled usage. The first enabled tab is active when omitted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the whole tab list is disabled: no tab can be selected by click or keyboard.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM `id` of the tabs root element; the trigger and panel ids derive from it. Generated when omitted.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of tabs to display, in order.
examples:
import { Tabs } from 'moraine'

<Tabs
  defaultValue="code"
  items={[
    { value: 'code', label: 'Code', icon: 'icon-code' },
    { value: 'preview', label: 'Preview' },
    { value: 'history', label: 'History', disabled: true },
  ]}
/>

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether arrow-key navigation wraps from the last tab to the first and back. Disabled tabs are skipped.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the tab's `value` when the user selects a different tab by click or keyboard.
It does not fire for programmatic `value` changes, for the already-active tab, or while the
tabs are `disabled`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction in which tabs are laid out. It also decides which arrow keys move between tabs.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled active tab value. When `undefined`, or when it matches no enabled tab, the first enabled tab is active.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual treatment of the tab list. `pill` sets the tabs on a muted rounded track and marks the
selected tab with a raised background. `link` uses a transparent list, colors the selected
tab with the primary color, and marks it with a thin underline (an edge line when vertical).

item.description: An individual tab in the tabs component.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of the tab trigger, set as its `aria-label`. It replaces the name computed
from `label` and also names the tab panel, which is labelled by the trigger. Use it for
icon-only tabs.

props.name: content
props.description:
Content of the tab panel. Only the active tab's panel is mounted; switching tabs unmounts the
previous one. Accepts static JSX or a component receiving `{ value }`, which defers building the panel until it is shown.
examples:
import { Tabs } from 'moraine'

Summary

}, { value: 'logs', label: 'Logs', content: (props) =>

Panel for {props.value}

}, ]} />

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tab is disabled: it cannot be selected and is skipped by arrow-key navigation.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display before the label.

props.name: label
props.description:
Label to display on the tab trigger. It is also the tab's accessible name unless `ariaLabel`
is set, so give icon-only tabs an `ariaLabel`.

props.name: value
props.description:
Unique value identifying the tab in `value` and `onValueChange`. A tab that repeats an earlier
tab's value is disabled.
